sentences.text: Heard Mr. LR Mazumder, learned counsel for the petitioner.

The claim of the petitioner for zirat compensation was negated by the authorities for the reason that the construction carried out was pursuant to the issuance of notice under Section 3(A) of the National Highways Act.

According to the petitioner, under Section 3D(2), a land so acquired by the National Highways shall vest on the Central Government free from all encumbrances from publication of notice under Section 3D and that being the position, any construction carried out between issuance of notice under Section 3(A) and publication of notice under Section 3D, land owner is entitled for zirat compensation.
Issue notice, returnable after six weeks.
Mr. N Das, learned State counsel accepts notices on behalf of respondent Nos. 3 and 4, Mr. C Baruah, learned standing counsel for the NHAI accepts notice on behalf of respondent No. 6, Mr.
RK Talukdar, leaned standing counsel NHIDCL accepts notices Page No.# 3/3 on behalf of respondent Nos. 1 and 2 and Mr. R Dhar, learned standing counsel for the PWD accepts notice on behalf of respondent No. 5.
As all the respondents are duly represented, no formal notice needs to be issued.
However, extra copies, in required numbers, be furnished to them within a period of five days from today.
